name: Paint Chips
summary: A colour wheel that deals harmony paint chips and paints them straight into a little living room
about: A wall colour picker for a room planner. Drag the knob round the wheel and its harmony partners follow on springs, joined by a live shape, while a small living room repaints its wall, sofa, curtains and cushions in the palette. Each paint chip shows three tints, a paint name and its hex code, and the contrast badge tells you whether text on that wall stays readable.
how: Drag anywhere on the wheel, or focus the knob and use the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps)
Move the Lightness slider or type a hex code such as #2A9D8F; wrong characters are flagged at once
Pick Pair, Triad, Nearby, Split or Square and the chips fold away and deal in again
Press a chip to copy its hex code; a drop of paint falls and a tick confirms it
